artworks.title: A Breton Boy with a Jug; Five Animal Forms [verso]
artworks.medium: crayon and graphite on wove paper
artworks.description: The image shows a colored sketch on the left side and some light pencil sketches on the right. The left side displays a young boy in a three-quarter body view, bent forward slightly, as if pouring from a large red jug he's holding with both hands. The boy's face is visible in profile, with faint features, and he has short, light-colored hair. He is wearing a loose-fitting blue outfit with a long sleeve top and pants. His head is topped with a floppy blue hat. The background is filled with light green and yellow shading, with indistinct forms suggesting an outdoor setting. There is a faint signature or writing on the left side of the drawing near his shoulder. On the right side, there are light pencil sketches of various objects or forms, which are not clearly defined. The overall background on this side is plain.

artworks.title: Group of Human Forms; A Man Seated [recto]
artworks.medium: crayon on wove paper
artworks.description: The image shows abstract, curving black lines forming shapes resembling figures and landscapes. Two vertical lines on the left suggest a standing figure, while adjacent curved lines resemble draped fabric. Wavy lines on the right create movement resembling hills or waves, and intersecting lines suggest objects like trees or architectural elements. The drawing provides hints of people and nature interacting with surroundings.

artworks.title: Figure Studies; Studies of Soldiers [verso]
artworks.medium: crayon on wove paper
artworks.description: The image consists of two panels with minimalist line drawings. The left panel shows figures from the shoulders up in abstract detail, with simple indications of clothing and surroundings. The right panel includes figures from the waist up, with more defined outlines. One figure has a beard and a brimmed hat, and another is shown wearing a coat with buttons. Various hat forms and simplified profiles are also included in the sketches. The background of both panels is blank.

artworks.title: Circles and Numbers; Self-Portrait [recto]
artworks.medium: crayon and graphite on wove paper
artworks.description: The image is divided into two panels. The right panel displays a partial view of a person from the shoulders upwards, positioned facing slightly to the left with their head turned towards the viewer. The person has short, straight hair with a fringe and facial features that include a beard and mustache. The facial features are loosely sketched, emphasizing the eyes, nose, and lips. The clothing appears to be a collared shirt. The left panel features various circular sketches and numerals scattered across the page. In the background of both panels, the space is plain, with no distinct objects, details, or additional context surrounding the drawings.

artworks.title: Breton Boy in a Landscape; Study of an Arm [verso]
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink and graphite on wove paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a sketched figure and an anatomical study. The left side shows a loose pencil outline of a figure wearing a hat and cloak, possibly hidden behind rocks with a rifle pointed forward. On the right side, there is a detailed sketch of an arm bone with cursive notes. This drawing combines quick sketches and detailed anatomical study.

artworks.title: Two Heads; Studies of Sheep [recto]
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink and graphite on wove paper
artworks.description: There are two sketches on the page. On the left, there are profiles of two heads. The first head faces left with delicate features, a prominent nose, and styled hair. Below this is a child's profile, also facing left with short hair. The right side shows abstract sketches including facial parts, a hand, and an object resembling a nose. The background is plain with a light brown tint and small, round white spots across the page, focusing on the line drawings.

artworks.title: Five Sheep; Four Head Studies [verso]
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink and graphite on wove paper
artworks.description: The drawing displays abstract shapes and lines across a two-panel composition. The left panel features elongated forms resembling draped fabrics or fish-like figures, filled with sketched lines. The right panel includes abstract profiles and busts of human faces, one encircled. The elements suggest human portraits and flowing garments in an abstract arrangement.

artworks.title: Head of a Man with a Study of His Back; Various Sketches with a Peasant Woman and a Goose [recto]
artworks.medium: graphite and crayon on wove paper
artworks.description: The image shows a series of faint pencil sketches on two adjacent panels, resembling a sketchbook. On the left panel, there are lightly drawn outlines of faces – one appearing to be a man and another a woman. The faces are partially sketched and appear unfinished. The right panel features various small sketches, including a person's profile from the shoulders up, a simplistic figure with outstretched arms next to a small animal, and a couple of abstract or partially formed shapes resembling heads and faces. The sketches are simplistic with minimal detail, created using light, feathery lines. The background is plain, with the off-white paper of the sketchbook. The two panels are bordered with a thin line, providing structure to the open sketchbook format.

artworks.title: A Grazing Cow; Head of a Woman with Her Hand on Her Cheek, and Head of a Man with His Hand on His Ear [verso]

The right panel features sketches of two human faces and a partial figure. The top sketch shows a person with stylized facial features, with their hand resting on the side of their face. Below is another sketch of a person with facial hair and a hand on their face. Next to these sketches is an unfinished outline of a figure or object. The composition is on a plain, light paper with faint darker strokes, enclosed in a simple frame.

On the left side, there is a full-body drawing of a person turned slightly away, wearing a long skirt, a shawl or cloak, and a hat or bonnet. The second figure in the background is a roughly sketched person standing in profile. On the right side, there is a colored sketch of a monkey's head, which appears to be resting on something. Below the monkey's head is another small sketch. The background of both panels is plain.

Both sketches have plain backgrounds.

artworks.title: Two Cows; A Seated Breton Woman [verso]
artworks.medium: crayon on wove paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of abstract sketches. The drawing consists of two panels with minimalist sketches in black on a light-colored background. The left panel features rough sketches, including one that resembles a four-legged animal. Above the sketches, there is cursive writing in a darker tone. The right panel includes more abstract lines and shapes resembling parts of a human figure or an abstract structure, focusing on light and shadow. The drawings convey quick, expressive strokes and appear to be explorations of form and composition.

artworks.title: Five Sheep; Head of a Woman and Head of a Bearded Man [recto]

artworks.description: The image is a double-page sketch with two different sets of drawings, separated by a vertical line in the middle. On the right page, two partial sketches of human faces are visible. One shows a person facing slightly to the left with the forehead, eyes, nose, and lips visible. This figure has short, dark hair. Below it, another sketch shows a man's head in three-quarter view with a full beard, mustache, and short hair. Both sketches focus on facial features with loose strokes for hair and expressions. The left page has a series of sketchy, upside-down drawings that appear to be partial figures of animals, possibly cats, sketched with minimal detail. There is handwriting below the sketches, but it is not legible. The background is plain, with no color or context, emphasizing the sketches.

artworks.title: Crouching Monkey and Man's Head; Bones and Muscles [verso]

On the left, there is a figure composed of curved lines that resemble a crouching person, with additional rough sketches near it. The phrase "c'est un cul de jatte" is written below the central figure. On the right, the drawing features vertical and slightly curved lines intersected by round and oval shapes, resembling elongated figures or tall objects. These compositions suggest movement and abstract representation of human and natural forms through simple linework.

The page seems to be a study or practice page showing various elements in a casual and experimental way.

artworks.title: Four Studies of Breton Women; Shapes and Vases [verso]
artworks.medium: graphite and crayon on wove paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of various studies and sketches. On the left, there is a collection of sketches of human profiles and partial clothing, including hats or bonnets. At the top is a study of arm and garment textures, focusing on folds and fabric draping. On the right, there are abstract shapes, simplified forms, and graphic doodles, some with handwritten notations in a foreign language. The drawings have a rough, exploratory quality.

artworks.title: Five Studies of Soldiers and a Woman's Face; Two Figures [recto]
artworks.medium: crayon on wove paper
artworks.description: The image depicts sketchy outlines and partial views of figures spread across two panels. In the left panel, there are incomplete sketches of several individuals from varying angles, featuring only parts of their bodies. One figure is seen from the back, wearing a hat, while another's profile with a beard is apparent. The face of one individual shows some facial features, with prominent eyebrows and eyes partially visible, along with vague outlines of facial profiles with headgear. In the right panel, one figure is drawn in a simplified silhouette, suggesting a profile of a person in an overcoat. Another figure is roughly sketched with a noticeable cap, and the rest of the lines are sparse, depicting human forms in minimal detail without distinct facial features. The artwork lacks detailed information on clothing textures or colors. The background is a plain paper texture with no significant details or elements besides the sketched lines.

artworks.title: Soldiers; Four Soldiers and a Seated Figure [verso]
artworks.medium: crayon on wove paper

The right side contains multiple small studies of a man in various poses, focusing on facial expressions and headgear. The central figure wears a broad-brimmed hat and is shown in profile. Above him are two smaller sketches of faces, one with eyes covered by a hat. Below the central figure, there are sketches of a man sitting and another profile with distinctive sideburns, both wearing hats. The background is plain, highlighting the line-focused nature of the sketches.

artworks.title: Church Tower; A Sketch of a Fan [recto]
artworks.medium: graphite on wove paper
artworks.description:
The image shows two sketches on separate panels. 

On the left panel, there is a sketch of a tall, slender structure resembling a church steeple or tower. The spire extends upwards, slightly off-center to the left. A small, ambiguous shape is near the lower third of the panel to the right.

The right panel features abstract, faint lines indicating a figure in the upper part and a semicircular form with a vague human shape inside in the lower part. The sketches are minimalistic, rendered with light, precise strokes. The overall color palette is monochromatic, with the natural tone of the paper dominant.

artworks.title: Boy's Face; Two Sheep [verso]

The face includes basic features such as eyes, a nose, and a mouth with open lips. The hair is represented by curved lines, and one ear is larger. The right side shows faint outlines resembling a vague figure or abstract form without distinct facial features. The background of the image is plain.

artworks.title: A Profile and Four Shapes; Sketch of a Man's Head [recto]
artworks.medium: crayon, graphite, and pen and brown ink on wove paper
artworks.description: The image shows an abstract arrangement of shapes and lines. There are angular forms, freehand sketches, jagged lines resembling a human profile, triangles resembling folded paper or a mountain range, parallel lines with scattered numbers resembling a list or data chart, and vertical lines resembling a stylized human figure or furniture. The composition invites connections to everyday objects like faces, hills, or lists.
